en.headline: Government launches third InnoHK platform with HK$2.5 billion
en.dek: SEAM@InnoHK opened at the Science Park on Tuesday with eight research centres focused on sustainability, energy, advanced manufacturing and new materials.
body: The Innovation and Technology Commission and the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation launched SEAM@InnoHK, the third InnoHK research cluster, at the Science Park on Tuesday. Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said the government had allocated about HK$2.5 billion and would work with about 30 partners from the Mainland and overseas.

The new platform extends InnoHK beyond Health@InnoHK and AIR@InnoHK into four areas: sustainability, energy, advanced manufacturing and new materials. Sun said projects would cover next-generation semiconductors, sustainable energy and new materials, aerospace and advanced manufacturing, and smart energy management, in line with the national 15th Five-Year Plan's emphasis on high-end manufacturing, strategic emerging industries and a greener economy.

Local reports said the eight research centres, approved at the end of March and hosted by five local universities and the Chinese Academy of Sciences Hong Kong Institute of Science and Innovation, are cooperating with institutions including the University of Cambridge, EPFL, Nagoya University, the National University of Singapore, Tsinghua University and Peking University. Three centres involve Nobel laureates in their research collaborations.

Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation chairwoman Fanny Chung said the first two InnoHK platforms had already delivered world-class results. Sun said Hong Kong's five universities in the global top 100, together with its role as a super-connector, should help attract firms, capital and researchers, and turn laboratory work into applications.

zh.headline: 第三個InnoHK研發平台啟動 政府撥款約25億元
zh.dek: SEAM@InnoHK周二於科學園開幕，八所研發中心聚焦可持續發展、能源、先進製造及新材料，夥約30個海內外機構。
body: 創新科技署聯同香港科技園公司周二為第三個InnoHK創新香港研發平台「SEAM@InnoHK」舉行啟動禮。創新科技及工業局局長孫東表示，政府為新平台撥款約25億元，並與約30個來自內地及海外的夥伴合作。
新平台在「Health@InnoHK」及「AIR@InnoHK」之外，把科研版圖伸延至可持續發展、能源、先進製造及新材料四個範疇。孫東指項目涵蓋下一代半導體、可持續能源與新材料、航天及先進製造技術，以及智慧能源管理，回應國家「十五五」規劃推動高端製造業、戰略性新興產業及綠色轉型的方向。
報道指八所研發中心於今年3月底獲批，由五所本地大學及中國科學院香港創新研究院主理，合作院校包括劍橋大學、洛桑聯邦理工學院、名古屋大學、新加坡國立大學、清華大學及北京大學等，其中三個中心有諾貝爾獎得主參與科研。
科技園公司主席鍾郝儀表示，首兩個InnoHK平台已取得世界級成果。孫東指香港有五所全球百強大學，加上超級聯繫人角色，有助吸引企業、資金及人才，加快科研成果落地。
